sources.population: WorldPop 2024 China native 1km constrained population raster; DOI 10.5258/SOTON/WP00840
sources.geocoder: OpenStreetMap Nominatim; named residential override where present, otherwise county/town government or settlement proxy
sources.geometry: Third-party coded 2025 county polygons; exact code/name match required

method.point_buffer: 5km radius around the original named residential reference or explicitly marked county-seat proxy; cells clipped to exact candidate polygon
method.weighting: WorldPop native 1km population-grid cell counts; Bio1/Bio12 sampled at those population-cell centers
method.metrics: population-weighted mean and weighted P10/P50/P90; valid population coverage correctly calculated
method.confidence: HIGH >=5 valid inhabited climate cells and >=90% population coverage and >=500 residents; MEDIUM >=2 cells and >=75% coverage; else LOW

limitations: OSM geocoding does not prove actual chosen residential block; results are settlement-proxy climate and must be checked against source altitude and historical station data.
A county-seat proxy is not a specific residential neighborhood; geocode role is preserved for review.
No final A/B/C/D grades or formal exclusions are assigned by this extraction.
Nine exact boundary/code mismatches remain pending; they are not imputed.
